name: Corn-Soy Ratio vs Crush Spread: Z-Score Divergence Monitor
description: Overlays the corn/soy ratio z-score and the soybean crush spread z-score to visualize divergences between the two signals. Computes: (1) corn/soy ratio = ZC/ZS, (2) crush spread = ZM*0.024 + ZL*0.11 - ZS/100, (3) 252-day rolling z-scores of both, (4) divergence = crush_zscore - ratio_zscore, (5) 20-day MA of divergence, (6) 63-day z-score of divergence itself. Positive divergence means crush margins are rich relative to corn cheapness vs beans.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN-SOY RATIO vs CRUSH SPREAD: Z-SCORE DIVERGENCE MONITOR
# =============================================================================
# Overlays rolling z-scores of the corn/soy price ratio and the soybean crush
# spread to identify divergences between relative grain pricing and processing
# margins. Positive divergence = crush rich / ratio cheap; negative = opposite.
#
# Inputs:
#   ZC (Corn) — primary asset with futures continuation
#   ZS (Soybeans), ZM (Soybean Meal), ZL (Soybean Oil) — reference futures
#
# Calculations:
#   Corn/Soy Ratio   = ZC close / ZS close
#   Crush Spread      = ZM * 0.024 + ZL * 0.11 - ZS / 100  ($/bushel)
#   ratio_zscore      = 252-day rolling z-score of ratio
#   crush_zscore      = 252-day rolling z-score of crush spread
#   divergence        = crush_zscore - ratio_zscore
#   divergence_ma20   = 20-day SMA of divergence
#   divergence_zscore = 63-day rolling z-score of divergence
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
# Primary: Corn with proper continuation
src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zc_close = zc_cont.c

# Reference futures for soybeans complex
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZS")()
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZM")()
zl_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZL")()

zs_close = zs_ref.c
zm_close = zm_ref.c
zl_close = zl_ref.c

# --- Core Calculations ---
# Corn/Soy price ratio
corn_soy_ratio = zc_close / zs_close

# Soybean crush spread ($/bushel)
# 1 bushel soybeans -> ~48 lbs meal + ~11 lbs oil
# ZM quoted in $/ton, ZL in cents/lb, ZS in cents/bushel
crush_spread = zm_close * 0.024 + zl_close * 0.11 - zs_close / 100

# --- Z-Scores (252-day rolling) ---
ratio_zscore = zscore(window=252)(corn_soy_ratio)
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush_spread)

# --- Divergence Analysis ---
# Positive = crush is elevated relative to corn/soy ratio
# (processing margins rich, but corn cheap vs beans)
divergence = crush_zscore - ratio_zscore

# Smoothed divergence (20-day SMA)
divergence_ma20 = ma(period=20)(divergence)

# Z-score of the divergence itself (63-day) — detect extreme divergences
divergence_zscore = zscore(window=63)(divergence)

# 63-day average divergence for summary
divergence_avg63 = ma(period=63)(divergence)

# --- Timestamps for XY Lines ---
ts = index().value

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Ratio Z-Score vs Crush Z-Score overlay
xy_lines(
    title='Corn-Soy Ratio vs Crush Spread Z-Scores',
    category='Divergence Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (σ)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corn/Soy Ratio Z', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread Z', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='+1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.0, title='-1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio_zscore, crush_zscore))

# Chart 2: Divergence with 20-day MA
xy_lines(
    title='Crush vs Ratio Divergence (+ = Crush Rich / Ratio Cheap)',
    category='Divergence Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Divergence (σ)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Divergence', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='+1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.0, title='-1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(divergence, divergence_ma20))

# Chart 3: Divergence Z-Score (extremes detector)
xy_lines(
    title='Is the Divergence Itself Extreme? (63d Z-Score)',
    category='Divergence Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Divergence Z-Score (σ)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Divergence Z', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5, title='+1.5σ', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.5, title='-1.5σ', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(divergence_zscore,))

# Summary Table: Current snapshot of key metrics
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Current Z-Score Snapshot',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        col_headers=['Ratio Z', 'Crush Z', 'Divergence', 'Div Z-Score', '63d Avg Div'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio Z', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Z', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Divergence', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Div Z-Score', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='63d Avg Div', grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Divergence Analysis',
    order=4
)(ratio_zscore, crush_zscore, divergence, divergence_zscore, divergence_avg63)
